'''Talon Squadron''' was a [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] of [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] in the [[Imperial Navy (Sith Empire)|Imperial Navy]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. Talon, [[Striker Squadron (Sith Empire)|Striker]], and [[Viper Squadron (Sith Empire)|Viper]] Squadrons were shot down by the [[Balmorran resistance]], and Imperial forces rescued the survivors from the resistance.
